mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse in RETAIL_REC and TRANSIT indicates a broad withdrawal from out-of-home activity; as transit use stays depressed, discretionary retail trips continue to fall, pushing next-4-week RETAIL_REC below its last-4-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly mean fell from -58.4 to -66.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -60 percent change.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT crosses below -60, commuting and discretionary trips are suppressed enough that retail footfall cannot recover; the threshold crossing predicts continued RETAIL_REC decline over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -60 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days after TRANSIT has closed below -60 percent change from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in WORKPLACES means more people are home instead of commuting; the resulting loss of workplace-adjacent retail traffic drives RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 17.7 and WORKPLACES is -31.4 in t-0w
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL > 15 and WORKPLACES < -30, next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a strict Stage 3 lockdown, park visits and grocery/pharmacy trips both fall as movement is legally restricted; the same restriction directly closes or limits retail venues, so RETAIL_REC declines within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -37.9 and GROCERY_PHARM is -11.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: Within seven days under Stage 3, RETAIL_REC does not fall further after PARKS is below -30 percent change.

mechanism_narrative: Households cutting even essential grocery/pharmacy trips signal heightened infection fear; this caution spills into discretionary retail, depressing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from -2.9 to -11.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 14 days is not lower when GROCERY_PHARM declines below -10 percent change from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Southern-hemisphere winter reduces outdoor park use, and with restrictions in place the seasonal pull indoors reinforces lower retail footfall, keeping RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -37.9 in t-0w during Melbourne winter
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 28 days rises despite PARKS staying below -30 percent change in winter.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of a transit collapse and a workplace exodus removes two independent sources of retail footfall; when both are below their thresholds, retail trips fall more than either alone, so RETAIL_REC declines over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -66.0 and WORKPLACES is -31.4 in t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT < -60 and WORKPLACES < -30 simultaneously, next-14-day RETAIL_REC is not lower than last-14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rising RESIDENTIAL series shows people are complying with stay-at-home orders; because retail and recreation venues depend on out-of-home traffic, continued residential elevation predicts a further one-week drop in RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 11.6 to 17.7 over the four weeks ending t-0w
failure_condition: In an escalating lockdown, RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after RESIDENTIAL exceeds +15 percent change.
